title: Non-survival rat endovascular testbed for early-stage evaluation of untethered magnetic microrobots
author: Wang, Le, et al.

steps.title: Induce anesthesia and analgesia
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the rat with 3 % isoflurane in oxygen at a flow rate of 0.75 L/min for induction, then inject pentobarbital sodium intraperitoneally (50 mg/mL stock, 50 mg/kg). Maintain anesthesia with supplemental pentobarbital doses of 20 mg/kg IP every 50–60 min as needed, and provide pre‑operative analgesia by subcutaneous buprenorphine hydrochloride (0.3 mg/mL stock, 0.1 mg/kg).

substeps.instruction: Deliver 3 % isoflurane in O₂ at 0.75 L/min for induction.
Inject pentobarbital sodium IP (50 mg/mL stock, 50 mg/kg).
Give supplemental pentobarbital IP (20 mg/kg) every 50–60 min if required.
Administer buprenorphine hydrochloride SC (0.3 mg/mL stock, 0.1 mg/kg).

steps.title: Prepare rat and maintain temperature
steps.instruction: After confirming deep surgical anesthesia, place the rat supine, secure its limbs, shave and disinfect the abdomen, apply a sterile drape, and keep the animal normothermic using a heating pad.

substeps.instruction: Position rat supine and secure limbs.
Maintain normothermia with a heating pad.

steps.title: Perform midline laparotomy and exteriorize intestines
steps.instruction: Make an approximately 3 cm midline laparotomy to enter the peritoneal cavity, then gently exteriorize the small intestine and cecum onto pre‑warmed, saline‑moistened gauze to keep tissues hydrated and minimize injury.

substeps.instruction: Exteriorize small intestine and cecum onto pre‑warmed, saline‑moistened gauze.

steps.title: Expose infrarenal inferior vena cava
steps.instruction: Identify the infrarenal IVC to the right of the pulsatile abdominal aorta by its darker color and thinner, collapsible wall, locate it between the renal veins and iliac bifurcation, and select a distal, relatively branch‑free segment for exposure.

substeps.instruction: Locate IVC right of abdominal aorta (darker, thinner wall).
Identify segment between renal veins and iliac bifurcation.
Choose distal, branch‑free portion for exposure.

description: The overall experimental workflow is illustrated in Fig. 1. Briefly, the procedure consists of surgical exposure of the IVC, followed by catheter-based deployment of the microrobot and fluoroscopic-guided navigation under magnetic actuation. The platform integrates vascular access, physiologically relevant flow conditions, real-time imaging, and external magnetic control within a controlled in vivo environment. The following sections describe each step of the protocol in detail.Fig. 1Experimental workflow for in vivo evaluation of untethered endovascular microrobots in a non-survival rat model. (i) Standardized peripheral vascular access with deployment of a model, physiologically compatible endovascular microrobot (EndoBot)[4]. (ii) Surgical exposure of IVC. (iii) IVC cannulation using a Seldinger-based technique. (iv) Fluoroscopy-guided magnetic navigation using a robot-arm-mounted magnet integrated with X-ray imaging.Fig 1 dummy alt text
